summary.text: Mark Fisher is the Republican candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Fisher is listed on the District 13 general-election ballot alongside Democrats Pam Lanman Guzzone, Gabriel Moreno and Amy Brooks for the district's three seats.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Fisher described himself as an entrepreneur, speaker and community advocate who has worked with individuals, families and business owners on financial security.

He listed three key messages: lowering the cost of living by making government more focused, efficient and accountable; improving public safety by supporting law enforcement and strengthening accountability in the justice system; and expanding economic opportunity by supporting small businesses and cutting unnecessary barriers to growth.
